# Portfolio Workspace Instructions

The complete portfolio specification is maintained in
the root developer.agent.md file.

Before implementing significant changes, read and
follow the complete specification.

Inspect the existing workspace before modifying files.

Build a responsive, premium Azure Solutions Architect
and DevOps portfolio using Next.js, TypeScript,
Tailwind CSS, and reusable components.

Preserve existing working code.

Do not fabricate project achievements, certifications,
metrics, or client details.

Do not expose secrets or confidential infrastructure.

Implement actual working code, not just plans or
code snippets in chat.

Run the application, verify the build, and report
the changes and unresolved issues.
